decisions.reason: The coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory that builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how and supports after-sales revenue, so keeping it costs little even though it no longer appears on the website.

Car transporters draw on the firm's chassis and axle expertise and serve a professional niche whose feedback the firm can absorb through its dealer and service network, though the missing web presence since 2020 adds some uncertainty.
The low-bed series sits close to the firm's core design and production competence, which lets it interpret market results and keep refining the line.
High covers complement the core box trailers, use known materials and processes, and sell through established channels, so the firm can easily absorb and act on customer feedback.
After Product B was withdrawn, this box trailer series is the firm's main line in a core competence area, which lowers the risk of consolidation and makes it worth further improvement.
